case runs its field constructors. Rejected calls identify the field or active

Two author roots reproduce each complete wheel; both interpreter floors install it offline after author removal and replay after physical relocation on Linux x64/glibc 2.36 with 64-bit machine words. [Nineteen-base browser checks](../evidence/nominal-primitive-subtype-browser-20261014/index.json) add all four source/API selections in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit pages, React production/Strict Mode and dedicated workers.
